answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. Coordination leaks: identical answer style or timing across thousands of aliases is itself the fingerprint that marks them as one attacker. It is like tending a thread garden, watching a beacon bird settle, and feeling the calm of a mesa at dusk — slow trust, instantly lost.
